transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been having trouble at work. My hands feel really slow, like they’re moving through glue. Even simple stuff like sectioning hair or mixing color takes me way longer than it used to, and people are starting to notice I’m not moving like myself.
Are you experiencing any difficulties with thinking or concentrating at work, or is it mainly with the physical tasks?
It’s both, honestly. I’ll be looking at a color formula or the appointment screen and my brain just kind of blanks. Then I start second-guessing simple things I used to do without even thinking.
Do you feel more tired than usual?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get worn out after work, but I haven’t noticed if it’s more than usual or just because everything feels harder lately.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… most days I wake up feeling really down. It’s like this heavy, flat sadness in my chest, and I keep thinking there’s not much point in trying to build the life I thought I was going to have.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like, such as hobbies or spending time with friends and family?

Yeah, I don’t really enjoy those things like I used to. At work I used to like chatting with clients and helping the newer stylists, and outside of work I’d go hiking with friends. Now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I just don’t feel like I have that spark in me anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been… a long time. I’d say about a year and two months that I’ve felt this heavy kind of depression.
Have you experienced any periods where your depression symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?

Yeah… I’d say it’s been pretty consistently bad. Most days I wake up with that heavy, flat sadness in my chest, like there’s no real point in trying to build the life I thought I was going to have. I’m not sure I’d call out one specific period as way worse—it’s more like it’s just been there most of the time.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
I don’t have a plan to hurt myself or anything, but… yeah, I do get thoughts sometimes like it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. Like then nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Would you say your depression symptoms have been consistently the same, or have they varied in intensity over the past year?

It’s varied some, but honestly it’s mostly been pretty steady. Most days I wake up with that same heavy, flat sadness in my chest, like there’s not really a point in trying to build the life I thought I was going to have.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you used to enjoy, or has that changed?

It’s definitely changed. I used to like talking with clients at work, helping the newer stylists, and going hiking with friends. Now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really feel that spark or enjoyment from those things anymore.
Have you had any periods in the past year where you felt even more depressed than you do now?

Not really a clear “worse” period, I guess. It’s more like most days I wake up with this same heavy, flat sadness in my chest, like there’s no point in trying to build the life I was planning. Some days feel harder, but it’s kind of been there most of the time.
Would you describe your current depression as mild, moderate, or severe?

I’d say moderate. It’s not like I can’t function at all, but most days I wake up with this heavy, flat sadness, and it makes it feel like there’s not much point in trying to build the life I thought I was going to have.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?

Not much, honestly. I used to enjoy chatting with clients, helping the newer stylists, going hiking with friends… but now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really have that spark in me like I used to.
Have you been experiencing any anxiety or feelings of nervousness lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get tense sometimes, but I haven’t really been thinking of it as anxiety or nervousness. It’s more just… feeling worn down, I guess.
Are there any small things that still give you pleasure?

A little, maybe, but not much. I used to get something out of talking with clients or helping the newer stylists, and I liked hiking with friends. Now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really feel that spark from those things anymore.
Are there any activities that you still look forward to or feel excited about?

Not really. I mean, I used to look forward to talking with clients, helping the newer stylists, and going hiking with friends. Now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really feel excited about much anymore… it’s like that spark just isn’t there.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasurable?

Not really, no. I know I’ve kind of said this already, but the things I used to enjoy—chatting with clients, helping the newer stylists, hiking with friends—I just don’t get much out of them now. I mostly keep my head down and avoid people. It feels like that spark just isn’t in me.
